title: Les Misérables
author: Victor Hugo
summary: Ex-convict Jean Valjean tries to build an honest life in nineteenth-century France while a relentless police inspector pursues him. He becomes protector of a girl named Cosette against the backdrop of revolt in Paris.
readIf: you want a vast, emotional story of mercy, justice and sacrifice, and don't mind its long digressions.
skipIf: you want a quick read, since the novel includes extended essays on history and architecture.

pairings.reason: Another giant French novel about a wronged man and a changed identity, with more adventure and revenge.
A shorter Dickens novel of sacrifice and revolution in the same era.
Another novel that spotlights the poor and the criminal with compassion.
